description: Append a labeled precedent to a taste profile's corpus — the growth loop. Use when a human accepts/revises/rejects an audit_taste finding or labels a new wrong→right example. Append-only: existing records are never rewritten. accept-verdict precedents suppress matching findings in future audit_taste runs.

artifact.description: What was judged (path, URL, or short description).

verdict.description: accept = the flagged pattern is fine (suppresses future matches); revise/reject = confirmed wrong.

violated_rule.description: The rule_id the label concerns ('' if none). Must exist in the profile.

wrong.description: The wrong pattern — use a verbatim snippet so accept-suppression can match it.

name: label_finding
